descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Stand on the ramparts, draw your bow and stop the army before your gate falls. Kale Muhafızı VR (Castle Guardian) brings Seljuk-inspired castle defense to VR.

• 14 campaign chapters, from the Castle Gate to Twilight Pass, Banner Hill and the Siege Ring. Earlier chapters now include tower archers, catapult batteries and distinct final leaders. Kara Arslan awaits in chapter 11.
• Counter each threat: break tower wheels, shoot a catapult rope to interrupt its attack, disrupt commanders and strike armored wardens when their weak points open. Raiders, javelin throwers, shield walls, ladder crews, medics and vanguards keep each siege varied.
• Manage fire, ice and bomb arrows across the whole chapter. Ammunition does not refill between waves; every two headshots reward one special arrow.
• Unlock 5 bows and 5 arrow types through victories. Shoot a power-up card between waves; use castle traps, focus and a triple volley to turn the battle.
• Draw with either hand, read brief changing winds and feel controller feedback. Play standing in place with snap turn; pause to change equipment and settings.
• Trial Arena, single-player offline play, English and Turkish.

The new siege trailer and screenshots are staged in-engine promotional captures.
